metadata.description: Argus — keeps important decisions alive as courses.

plugins.name: argus
plugins.description: Pressure-tests an important decision and returns a one-screen summary: recommendation, why, biggest open risk, alternative passed on, next concrete action — plus one falsifiable prediction you settle against reality later.

plugins.name: argus-driver
plugins.description: Thin driver for argus-decision-mcp. Installing it wires the MCP automatically so users can clarify a decision, save a testable prediction, and later record what actually happened. The model never grades the user.
